description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides data access methods for employee picture entities, including saving a new picture and retrieving a picture by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDao
classes.description: A data access object class for handling employee picture data, extending the BaseDao with methods to save and retrieve employee pictures.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Persists the EmpPicture entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpPicture entity based on the employee number; returns null if not found.
